gradeRuling.form: D-005 form. Is preview-product-boundary-successor.v12, as bytes, acceptable at application grade — T2-02's "application-grade acceptance with no express reservation" — as DR-117's preview-scoped design candidate? Answered against these bytes, not preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's and not preview-product-boundary-successor.v11's.
reasons: The measurement work is sound and, on the substance the dispatch names, complete. Every cross-lineage citation is current over both heading spellings, both moved partitions are stated as the current joins hold them, the doesNot union is the measured union exactly, the fourteen classes are provably unchanged beyond the enumerated 46 sites, D-316 is recited at its own words, and every one of the 109 recordedInputs digests matches live bytes with exact path closure. Nothing in this ruling questions any of that.

Application grade is withheld because the subject's own predecessor record is preview-product-boundary-successor.v11's, carried forward without re-derivation. authorityClaim says 'Its own history is this:' and gives a six-version history of a seven-version lineage. predecessorPinningShape says 'pins every predecessor' and names preview-product-boundary-successor.v6 and v9 as the rejected-and-unrecorded ones, when there are three. preview-product-boundary-successor.v11 is frozen at d25a7f29… with two Stage A REJECT verdicts on disk and is named nowhere in these bytes.

The omission is load-bearing, not cosmetic. A later SATISFIED-GRADE cycle resting on these bytes would read the lineage's history and standing from authorityClaim, predecessorStanding, doesNot[13] and recordedInputs, and would find no digest, no verdicts and no 'stays frozen; do not record it' sentence for an unrecorded artifact that two independent reviewers rejected — the sentence this same file supplies for preview-product-boundary-successor.v7, v8 and v9. An artifact that pins its own inputs to the byte should not lose a whole version of itself.

The subject also disposes every Stage A finding in this lineage from preview-product-boundary-successor.v2 through v9 and none of the ten preview-product-boundary-successor.v11 findings it was issued to land, while carrying two preview-product-boundary-successor.v11-minted identifiers whose 'V11' has no referent in the file. The repairs are present; the record of where they came from is not.

A successor that adds the preview-product-boundary-successor.v11 predecessor object, standing sentence, doesNot[13] entry, recordedInputs rows and finding dispositions, extends the two shape sentences, and disturbs nothing else would be answering a closed list.
